approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that reforms Norfolk Island's governance and extends mainland social security, immigration, health, and tax arrangements to the territory.

The package would abolish the Norfolk Island Legislative Assembly and Executive Council, establish an interim Advisory Council, and later apply New South Wales state law as Commonwealth law from 1 July 2016.

During an interim transition period starting after the passage of one bill, the Governor-General would have legislative power to make ordinances for the territory, subject to disallowance but not sunsetting provisions.
Abolishes the Norfolk Island Legislative Assembly and Executive Council.
Establishes an Advisory Council for community consultation.
Confers legislative power on the Governor-General to make ordinances.
Transfers executive powers to the Commonwealth Minister and Administrator.
Creates a new statutory position of Executive Director.
Norfolk Island residents, the Norfolk Island Government, and its administration.

The Health Insurance (Pathology) (Fees) Amendment (Norfolk Island) Bill 2015 was moved for second reading, amending fees payable under the Health Insurance Act 1973 for approved pathology authority undertakings and accredited pathology laboratory premises on Norfolk Island.
